annotations.title: Find the key for a fact

description: Ranked canonical fact keys for a plain-language question or a guessed key — "NI primary threshold", "ECB deposit rate", "passport renewal fee" — each with label, unit, period and verification date, and the full record of the top match when it is unambiguous. The keys feed `get_fact`. Filter by `namespace` (`uk`, `us`, `de`, `eu`).
